mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_base (id, user_id, name, description, api_key_id, embedding_model, dimension, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{apiKeyId}, #{embeddingModel}, #{dimension}, #{chunkSize}, #{chunkOverlap}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, description, api_key_id, embedding_model, dimension, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_base WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, name, description, api_key_id, embedding_model, dimension, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_base WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
